achievements.name: The Die Is Cast
achievements.description: Complete the campaign prologue, in which Titus is reinstated and rises again as a Primaris Space Marine.

achievements.description: Complete the campaign mission in which you retake the anti-aircraft batteries and destroy the Tyranid hive ship.
